approval: Proposed supplemental release contract; not part of frozen W0 35-command catalogue
authorization: Existing trusted company authentication and platform read policy; no caller-supplied identity/role override; API and CLI same policy
negativeCases: Missing build provenance returns explicit unavailable error; never mock current version
CLI token with same permissions as API yields same authorization decision
Output must not include credentials, paths, host inventory or user data
errorCompatibility: Implementation must use the existing error envelope and freeze schema in contract review before registration
